## Noise (estimate)

With 200 runs per cell, the standard error on a rate near 0.85 is about 0.025. Runs on the same ticket are correlated, so the real error is larger than that. The gap between A and B is 0.00, which is noise. The C drop of 0.06 is about 1.6 standard errors of the difference. That is not significant by itself. The check_status note names a specific cause, and that makes the drop more credible.
